notes.title: Eastern Game Fest + Demo Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825928/38cc8fe2702f594c345171f9370481332acf1401.png[/img]
[h3]Hello, Everyone![/h3]

Spirit Guardians is participating in the Eastern Game Fest, [b]with a brand new Demo released![/b]

The demo includes a brand new game mode. Hope you enjoy the pure Roguelike experience!

If you have any problems / BUG report/ gameplay suggestions, please feel free to leave them on our [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Discord[/url].

If you're interested in our game, please add Spirit Guardians to your wishlist↓
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742050/
